subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 2 – Lesson 5: Culture (special days in Oman)
outcomes: I can name things we have at Eid Al-Fitr.
I can say how people in Oman celebrate Eid.
I can talk about clothes for a special day.

tf.s: Eid Al-Fitr is a very special day in Oman.
tf.why: Yes! Eid Al-Fitr is very special in Oman.
Right! We celebrate Eid when Ramadan ends.

tf.s: People celebrate Eid Al-Fitr for the first three days of Shawwal.
tf.why: Well done! Eid is the first three days of Shawwal.

tf.s: People celebrate Eid Al-Fitr for one week.
tf.why: People celebrate for three days, not one week.

tf.s: At Eid, children get Eidiya, sweets and presents.
tf.why: Yes! Children love their Eidiya, sweets and presents.

tf.s: Eidiya is a kind of traditional hat.
tf.why: Eidiya is money that children get at Eid.

tf.s: At Eid, families eat special food.
tf.why: Great! Families share special food at Eid.

tf.s: At Eid, many people wear traditional clothes.
tf.why: Yes! Many people wear traditional clothes on special days.

tf.s: We say: They wearing traditional clothes.
tf.why: We need 're: They're wearing traditional clothes.

boxes.q: What money do children get at Eid?
boxes.why: Eidiya is the money children get at Eid.

boxes.q: Eid Al-Fitr is in the month of …
boxes.why: Eid is in the first three days of Shawwal.

boxes.q: Complete: Eid Al-Fitr is a ___ day in Oman.
boxes.why: Eid is a special day for everyone.

boxes.q: What do families eat at Eid?
boxes.why: Families eat special food at Eid.

boxes.q: What do we write at the top of the poster?
o: The name of the special day
boxes.why: The name of the special day goes at the top.

boxes.q: We celebrate Eid for how many days?
boxes.why: People celebrate for the first three days of Shawwal.

boxes.q: A good poster has pictures, labels and …
boxes.why: Pictures, labels and sentences make a clear poster.

boxes.q: When you present, your voice must be …
boxes.why: A clear voice helps everyone hear you.

hunt.q: Eid is in the month of …
A word next to a picture

mcq.why: Eid Al-Fitr is a very special day in Oman.

mcq.q: Which of these do children get at Eid?
mcq.why: Children get sweets, presents and Eidiya.

mcq.q: What do many people wear at Eid?
mcq.why: Many people wear traditional clothes at Eid.

mcq.q: Which word means a party for a happy day?

mcq.why: We say This is Eid Al-Fitr.

mcq.q: Your friend asks: What are they wearing? Choose the best answer.
mcq.why: They're wearing … tells us their clothes.

mcq.q: Label the white clothes an Omani man wears at Eid.
mcq.why: A dishdasha is the white traditional clothes for Omani men.

mcq.q: Ramadan ends today. What comes next?
mcq.why: Eid Al-Fitr comes right after Ramadan.

mcq.q: Ali has new clothes, sweets and Eidiya. Why?
mcq.why: Children get these things at Eid.

o: Big pictures, correct labels, clear sentences
mcq.why: Pictures, correct labels and sentences make a great poster.
